By modeling the structure of high-quality sampling distributions, SP directly generates cost-effective samples in the parameter space, significantly reducing the required sampling density while preserving solution quality.
  Experimental results show that SP achieves lower trajectory cost than the state-of-the-art FISS+ planner while using only one-eighth of the sampling density. In addition, SP demonstrates improved distance-keeping capability in obstacle-rich scenarios and maintains reduced and more stable runtime characteristics, indicating enhanced computational efficiency and predictable runtime behavior.
tldr: This paper proposes a CVAE-based hybrid planner that learns conditional distributions of effective trajectory parameters to reduce sampling density and runtime variability in sample-based motion planning for autonomous driving, achieving lower trajectory cost than FISS+ with one-eighth the samples.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于CVAE的混合规划器，通过学习有效轨迹参数的条件分布来降低自动驾驶中基于采样的运动规划的采样密度和运行时间波动，以八分之一的采样量实现了比FISS+更低的轨迹成本。
summary_zh:
轨迹规划是自动驾驶系统的核心组成部分，其实时性能与解的质量直接影响行车安全与可靠性。基于采样的运动规划方法（SBMP）因能够通过在参数空间中进行采样来逼近近似最优解而被广泛采用。然而，要获得高质量轨迹通常需要密集采样，这导致计算开销显著增加，并在复杂交通场景中产生较大的运行时间波动。

为解决上述问题，本文提出了一种稀疏规划器（SP），通过利用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）学习场景上下文与有效轨迹参数之间的条件关系，从而提高采样效率。SP通过对高质量采样分布的结构进行建模，能够在参数空间中直接生成具有成本效益的样本，从而在不降低解质量的前提下显著减少所需采样密度。

实验结果表明，在仅使用八分之一采样密度的情况下，SP所生成的轨迹成本仍低于现有最优方法FISS+。此外，SP在障碍物密集场景中展现出更强的保持距离能力，并具有更低且更稳定的运行时间特征，体现出更高的计算效率与可预测的运行行为。

title: RoboAssist: Interactive Human-Humanoid Planning for Long-Horizon Surgical Assistance
summary: Long-horizon surgical assistance requires humanoid robots to coordinate with evolving human activities while maintaining safety across planning and execution. We present RoboAssist, an agent-based framework for interactive human-humanoid planning that integrates workflow reasoning, task coordination, and cross-layer safety. At its core is an asymmetric dual-track representation that separates partially observed human process states from executable robot task sequences. By updating human-process estimates, scene context, and task dependencies online, RoboAssist revalidates the remaining task sequence and replans only the affected suffix when workflow requests change. A cross-layer safety architecture combines preventive navigation regulation, reactive regulation during close-range handover, and independent whole-body runtime supervision. This design couples online task coordination with safety constraints throughout execution. We demonstrate the framework on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot in long-horizon, multi-stage simulated surgical assistance scenarios encompassing multimodal interaction, instrument handling, medical material transport, navigation, and safe human-robot handover. Experiments show multi-stage task completion and adaptation to workflow-request changes. A targeted full-replanning ablation shows that residual replanning reduces plan-update latency and post-update token usage. Separate safety experiments demonstrate complementary protection across navigation, handover, and runtime supervision. Additional results and demonstrations are available online at https://roboassist.github.io.
tldr: RoboAssist presents an agent-based planning framework for long-horizon surgical assistance using a humanoid robot, featuring an asymmetric dual-track representation for dynamic replanning and a cross-layer safety architecture for navigation, handover, and runtime supervision, validated in simulated scenarios with a Unitree G1.
tldr_zh: RoboAssist 提出了一种基于智能体的规划框架，用于长期外科手术辅助人形机器人，通过非对称双轨表示实现动态重规划，并采用跨层安全架构保障导航、交接和运行时安全，在 Unitree G1 模拟场景中验证。
summary_zh: 长期手术辅助要求人形机器人在规划与执行过程中，既能与不断变化的人类活动保持协调，又能确保安全性。我们提出了RoboAssist，一个基于智能体的交互式人机协同规划框架，集成了工作流推理、任务协调和跨层安全保障。其核心是一种非对称双轨表示，将部分可观测的人类流程状态与可执行的机器人任务序列分离开来。通过在线更新人类流程估计、场景上下文和任务依赖关系，RoboAssist会在工作流请求发生变化时，对剩余任务序列进行重新验证，并仅对受影响的后续部分进行重新规划。跨层安全架构结合了预防性导航调控、近距离交接过程中的反应式调控，以及独立的全身体运行时监督。该设计在整个执行过程中将在线任务协调与安全约束紧密耦合。我们在Unitree G1人形机器人上，于模拟的长时程、多阶段手术辅助场景中验证了该框架，涵盖了多模态交互、器械操作、医疗物资运输、导航和安全的人机交接。实验结果表明，系统能够完成多阶段任务，并能适应工作流请求的变化。针对性的全量重规划消融实验显示，残差重规划有效降低了计划更新延迟及更新后的令牌使用量。独立的安全实验则验证了导航、交接和运行时监督之间的互补性保护效果。更多结果与演示可在线获取：https://roboassist.github.io。

title: FORTE: Forecasting Occupancy for Spatiotemporal Risk-Aware Planning in Dynamic Environments
summary: Safe navigation in dynamic environments requires anticipating future environmental states to account for spatiotemporal risks, specifically when and where collisions may occur. To this end, occupancy grid map (OGM) prediction has been widely adopted as an effective approach. However, existing OGM-based navigation methods often struggle to achieve accurate and efficient forecasting and fail to fully exploit the temporal information in predicted OGMs during planning. To address these challenges, we propose FORTE, a navigation framework that directly exploits the spatiotemporal evolution of predicted occupancy from the perspectives of spatiotemporal occupancy overlap and occupancy directivity. Based on these properties, FORTE evaluates multiple topology-distinct paths and selects the suitable one without explicit object detection or tracking. To support online planning, we formulate a latent diffusion model-based OGM predictor that generates the entire forecast horizon in a non-autoregressive manner while maintaining temporal consistency through temporal shift modules. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FORTE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. For prediction, FORTE achieves up to 215.3% higher IoU and 5.24x faster inference; for navigation, it yields up to a 3.5x higher success rate.
tldr: FORTE is a navigation framework that uses a latent diffusion model to predict occupancy grid maps (OGMs) non-autoregressively with temporal consistency, and exploits spatiotemporal properties (occupancy overlap and directivity) to select risk-aware paths for dynamic environments without explicit object detection or tracking.
tldr_zh: FORTE是一个导航框架，用潜在扩散模型非自回归地预测占用栅格地图(OGM)并保持时间一致性，利用时空属性(占用重叠和方向性)在无需目标检测或跟踪的情况下选择风险感知路径。
summary_zh: 在动态环境中实现安全导航，需预测未来的环境状态以评估时空风险，即确定碰撞可能发生的时间与位置。为此，占据栅格图（OGM）预测已被广泛采用，作为一种有效的方法。然而，现有的基于OGM的导航方法往往难以实现准确且高效的预测，并且在规划过程中未能充分利用预测OGM中的时间信息。为应对这些挑战，我们提出FORTE，一种导航框架，直接从时空占据重叠和占据方向性两个角度，利用预测占据状态的时空演变。基于这些特性，FORTE评估多条拓扑不同的路径，并在无需显式目标检测或跟踪的情况下选择合适的路径。为支持在线规划，我们构建了一个基于潜在扩散模型的OGM预测器，以非自回归方式生成整个预测范围，并通过时间移位模块保持时间一致性。大量评估表明，FORTE优于现有最先进的基线方法。在预测方面，FORTE的交并比（IoU）最高提升215.3%，推理速度提升5.24倍；在导航方面，其成功率最高提升3.5倍。

title: Scale and Selection: What Makes Automatic Harness Evolution Work for Visual-Interface Robot Agents
summary: When an off-the-shelf coding agent is used directly as a robot policy, observing a browser-based 3D interface through screenshots and acting by posing a virtual target gripper through a few tools, the agent's harness, its prompts, tools, and control rules, largely determines success, and until now it has been written by hand. We show that this harness can be improved automatically by another coding agent, the optimizer agent, and report two findings about what makes it work. First, the number of rollouts the optimizer agent sees per round governs whether the evolved harness is trustworthy, generalizes, and improves steadily. A single rollout is a noisy binary outcome, so with few rollouts per round a revision can be promoted on luck; enlarging the batch raises the signal-to-noise ratio of every promotion decision. Holding rounds fixed and growing the training set from 5 to 100 rollouts, held-out success rises from 47% to 67%, while small training sets overfit, reaching 70% on training tasks but only 54% held-out. Second, the optimizer agent must not be given free rein. With every revision it proposes accepted unconditionally, performance drifts downward within ten rounds as ill-judged edits accumulate; adding the most basic safeguard, Champion-Challenger selection that promotes a revision only if it strictly beats the incumbent on the same fixed evaluation set, turns the same loop into one that raises held-out success from 51% to 67% over 30 rounds. Automatic harness evolution for visual-interface robot agents is thus feasible, but its gains hinge on the rollout scale behind each decision and on how the optimizer agent's revisions are selected.
tldr: This paper shows that the harness (prompts, tools, control rules) of a coding-agent-based visual-interface robot policy can be automatically improved by an optimizer agent, and identifies rollout batch size and Champion-Challenger selection as critical factors for reliable gains.
tldr_zh: 本文表明，基于编码代理的视觉界面机器人策略的提示、工具和控制规则等“harness”可以由优化代理自动改进，并发现 rollout 批次大小和 Champion-Challenger 选择机制是实现可靠提升的关键因素。
summary_zh: 当现成的编码智能体直接用作机器人策略时，通过截图观察基于浏览器的三维界面，并借助少量工具通过设定虚拟目标夹爪来执行操作，该智能体的控制系统、提示词、工具及控制规则在很大程度上决定了成败，而迄今为止这些组件皆为手工编写。我们证明，这一控制系统可由另一个编码智能体——优化智能体——自动改进，并报告了关于其有效性的两项发现。首先，优化智能体每轮观察到的 rollout 数量决定了进化后的控制系统是否可信、是否具备泛化能力以及能否稳定改进。单次 rollout 是一个噪声较大的二元结果，因此若每轮 rollout 数量过少，修订可能仅凭运气获得晋升；增大批规模可提高每次晋升决策的信噪比。在轮次固定的情况下，将训练集从 5 个 rollout 扩展到 100 个，留出成功率从 47% 提升至 67%，而小训练集则出现过拟合，在训练任务上达到 70% 但在留出集上仅为 54%。其次，优化智能体不能被放任自流。若其每次提出的修订均无条件接受，则随着不当编辑的累积，性能在十轮内会逐步下滑；加入最基本的保障机制——冠军-挑战者选择，即仅当修订在相同固定评估集上严格优于当前方案时才予以晋升——可将同一循环转变为在 30 轮内使留出成功率从 51% 提升至 67% 的机制。因此，面向视觉界面机器人智能体的控制系统自动进化是可行的，但其收益取决于每项决策背后的 rollout 规模以及优化智能体修订的筛选方式。

title: Linear Recurrent Memory Suffices to Distil a World-Model Policy for Robot Air Hockey
summary: Does memory-dependent control need nonlinear recurrent dynamics? We study simulated air-hockey defence under temporary loss of puck tracking. A DreamerV3 teacher outperforms a memoryless policy under tracking loss, while resetting the teacher's recurrent state sharply reduces performance, which demonstrates that the task requires memory. We distil this teacher into compact recurrent policies with a 64 dimensional state, with a combination of a diagonal linear recurrence and an optional rank-$k$ nonlinear innovation while retaining nonlinear observation encoders and action heads. Across five matched seeds, the purely linear recurrent model ($k=0$) matches both the GRU baseline and the teacher throughout the tested range of tracking loss. Increasing nonlinear innovation rank providing no measured benefits. This result is obtained on a fresh test split, which will be only opened after all models and analyses are frozen. The linear model requires fewer recurrent parameters and less computation than GRU, but performs comparably. These results suggest that, for this memory dependent control task, nonlinear representation learning around a simple linear memory mechanism can be sufficient, and that nonlinear recurrent dynamics are not necessarily required. These conclusions are limited to the simulated task, teacher, state dimension, and blackout horizon considered here, and to policies whose observation encoder and action head remain nonlinear.
tldr: This paper investigates whether memory-dependent robot air hockey control requires nonlinear recurrent dynamics, showing that a linear recurrent policy distilled from a DreamerV3 teacher matches GRU baselines and the teacher's performance under temporary tracking loss, suggesting nonlinear recurrent dynamics may be unnecessary.
tldr_zh: 本文研究记忆依赖的机器人气垫球控制是否需要非线性循环动力学，表明从DreamerV3教师模型蒸馏出的线性循环策略在临时跟踪丢失情况下与GRU基线及教师表现相当，提示非线性循环动力学可能并非必需。
summary_zh: 记忆依赖的控制是否需要非线性循环动态？我们研究了在短暂丢失冰球追踪情况下的模拟冰球防守任务。一个DreamerV3教师模型在追踪丢失情况下的表现优于无记忆策略，而重置教师模型的循环状态则会显著降低其性能，这表明该任务确实需要记忆。我们将该教师模型蒸馏为具有64维状态的紧凑循环策略，结合了对角线性递推和可选的秩为$k$的非线性更新项，同时保留非线性的观测编码器和动作输出头。在五组匹配的随机种子下，纯线性递推模型（$k=0$）在测试的整个追踪丢失范围内均与GRU基线和教师模型表现相当。增加非线性更新的秩并未带来可衡量的性能提升。该结果是在全新的测试集上获得的，该测试集仅在所有模型和分析冻结之后才会开放。线性模型相比GRU需要更少的循环参数和计算量，但性能相当。这些结果表明，对于这项记忆依赖的控制任务，围绕简单线性记忆机制进行非线性表示学习可能已经足够，非线性循环动态并非必需。这些结论仅限于本文所考虑的模拟任务、教师模型、状态维度和中断时长，以及观测编码器和动作输出头保持非线性的策略。

title: Video2SwimFish: An Automated Pipeline for Reconstructing Controllable Fish Models and Biological Locomotion from Real Fish Videos
summary: We present Video2SwimFish, an automated pipeline and benchmark for building controllable fish assets from real-fish videos for underwater embodied AI. Given synchronized multi-view videos of an individual fish, the pipeline reconstructs a metrically scaled deformable mesh from a VLM-selected canonical frame, generates internal articulation adapted to that individual's morphology through a VLM actor-critic loop, and extracts a Biological Locomotion Manifold (BLM) from the fish's observed midline curvature. The BLM provides a low-dimensional action space bounded by real-fish motion, enabling an individual swimming policy to be learned for each reconstructed fish. We release two paired datasets: synchronized top- and front-view recordings of 120 individual fish across 6 species, and the controllable assets and individual swimming policies derived from them. Because every asset is tied to the animal it came from, the dataset supports a benchmark that evaluates locomotion learning not only on task success but on fidelity to that individual in trajectory shape, body curvature, and tail-beat frequency, across trajectory following, reward-free swimming behavior transfer from video, and a downstream case study in which a simulated BlueROV underwater robot captures one of the assets. We find that task success and locomotion fidelity do not necessarily improve together: the method achieving the highest task completion is not the method achieving the highest locomotion fidelity, and we identify faithful reproduction of individual animal locomotion as an open challenge for the community. Project website: https://hangongchen.github.io/video2swimfish-web/.
tldr: Video2SwimFish is an automated pipeline that reconstructs controllable, metrically scaled fish models and learns individual swimming policies from real multi-view fish videos, releasing a paired dataset and benchmark that evaluates locomotion fidelity beyond task success.
tldr_zh: Video2SwimFish 是一种自动流水线，可从真实多视角鱼类视频重建可控的、具有公制尺度的鱼类模型，并学习个体游泳策略，同时发布配对数据集和基准，评估超越任务成功率的运动保真度。
summary_zh: 我们提出了Video2SwimFish，一个用于从真实鱼类视频构建可控鱼类资产的全自动流程与基准，旨在服务水下具身智能研究。该流程以单条鱼的多视角同步视频为输入，首先从由VLM（视觉语言模型）选定的标准帧中重建出具有公制尺度的可变形网格，随后通过VLM演员-评论家循环生成适配该个体形态的内部关节结构，并从观测到的鱼体中线曲率中提取“生物运动流形”（Biological Locomotion Manifold, BLM）。该BLM提供了一个以真实鱼类运动为边界约束的低维动作空间，使得每条重建鱼均可学习到个体化的游泳策略。我们发布了两组配对数据集：一组包含6个物种共120条鱼的顶视与前视同步录像；另一组则是由此生成的可控资产及对应的个体游泳策略。由于每一项资产均与其来源动物一一对应，该数据集支持一种基准评估方式，不仅在任务成功率上评估运动学习效果，还在轨迹形状、身体曲率和尾拍频率等方面评估其对该个体运动保真度的影响，涵盖轨迹跟踪、基于视频的无奖励游泳行为迁移，以及一项下游案例研究——模拟BlueROV水下机器人捕获其中一项资产。我们发现，任务成功率与运动保真度并非必然同步提升：获得最高任务完成度的方法并非运动保真度最高的方法，我们将对个体动物运动的忠实复现视为社区面临的一项开放挑战。项目网站：https://hangongchen.github.io/video2swimfish-web/。

title: Local-Minimum Escaper: Programmatic Subgoal Generation for Robust Navigation in Unknown Environments
summary: Mapless navigation in unknown and partially observable environments remains challenging for mobile robots, particularly when local minima prevent the robot from making progress toward its goal. Existing local navigation methods often lack an explicit mechanism for escaping such situations, while deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches typically learn recovery behaviors implicitly through reward design and policy optimization. In this work, we propose \textbf{LME} (Local-Minimum Escaper), a programmatic hierarchical framework that explicitly generates and reasons subgoals to guide robots out of local-minimum regions. LME operates solely on local observations and selects candidate subgoals using interpretable heuristic criteria that account for both surrounding obstacle geometry and candidate-location safety. A local planner then generates low-level motion commands toward the selected subgoal. This design enables LME to handle environments both with and without local minima within a unified framework, while remaining independent of the underlying local planner and requiring no additional training. Extensive experiments in simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that LME provides robust navigation performance and generalizes to challenging unseen scenarios. Furthermore, the generated subgoals can be used to guide different local planners, substantially improving their ability to escape local minima. Successful deployments on both differential-drive and quadruped robots further demonstrate the practical applicability and generality of the proposed framework.
tldr: This paper introduces LME, a programmatic hierarchical framework for mobile robot navigation that explicitly generates safe subgoals to escape local minima, improving navigation robustness in unknown environments across differential-drive and quadruped robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LME，一种用于移动机器人导航的编程分层框架，通过显式生成安全子目标来逃离局部最小值，提升未知环境中导航的鲁棒性，并已在差分驱动机器人和四足机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 在未知且部分可观测环境中进行无地图导航对移动机器人而言仍具挑战性，尤其是当局部极小值阻碍机器人朝向目标前进时。现有的局部导航方法通常缺乏逃离此类情境的显式机制，而深度强化学习（DRL）方法则往往通过奖励设计和策略优化隐式地学习恢复行为。在本工作中，我们提出了\textbf{LME}（局部极小值逃逸器），一种程序化分层框架，通过显式生成并推理子目标来引导机器人脱离局部极小值区域。LME仅依赖局部观测，并采用可解释的启发式准则选择候选子目标，该准则同时考虑周围障碍物几何形状和候选位置的安全性。随后，局部规划器生成朝向所选子目标的底层运动指令。该设计使LME能够在统一框架内处理存在或不存在局部极小值的环境，同时保持与底层局部规划器的无关性，且无需额外训练。在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，LME提供了稳健的导航性能，并能泛化至具有挑战性的未见场景。此外，生成的子目标可用于引导不同的局部规划器，显著提升其逃离局部极小值的能力。在差速驱动机器人和四足机器人上的成功部署进一步证明了所提出框架的实用性和普适性。

title: PRICE the Action Chunks: Physical Relational Credit Assignment for Embodied Reinforcement Learning
summary: Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) post-trains vision--language--action policies using terminal success signals, but assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to every action chunk. A failed episode can thus penalize useful early actions as if they caused the failure. Existing approaches seek finer-grained feedback through learned evaluators, adding task-specific supervision or additional model training. We explore, for the first time to our knowledge, whether physical relations across trajectories can provide action-chunk credit in embodied RL from terminal outcomes alone, without an auxiliary evaluator. The key insight is that rollouts reaching corresponding physical situations can serve as references for one another: their terminal outcomes provide evidence for assessing local progress. We introduce Physical Relations for Inferring Credit from Episodes(PRICE), with two components: (i) a physical relational graph that pools current and historical outcomes at corresponding chunk boundaries to estimate success potentials; and (ii) confidence-gated credit assignment that uses changes in these potentials to refine trajectory-level supervision. Our analysis connects oracle potential changes to the terminal-success objective and provides a finite-sample directional bound for outcome-independent evidence pools. Independent continuation tests show that PRICE's retained credits align with local progress, while experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real robots demonstrate improved task success over outcome-based baselines and faster learning.
tldr: PRICE introduces a method for assigning action-chunk-level credit in embodied RL using physical relations across trajectories from terminal outcomes alone, improving task success in LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real robots.
tldr_zh: PRICE 提出了一种仅从终端结果出发，利用轨迹间的物理关系为动作块分配信用，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实机器人上提升任务成功率的方法。
summary_zh: 基于结果的强化学习（RL）通过终端成功信号对视觉-语言-动作策略进行后训练，但将相同的轨迹级优势分配给每个动作块。因此，一次失败的回合可能会惩罚早期有用的动作，仿佛它们导致了失败。现有方法通过学得的评估器寻求更细粒度的反馈，这需要添加任务特定的监督或额外的模型训练。据我们所知，我们首次探索了跨轨迹的物理关系是否能够仅从终端结果出发，在具身强化学习中提供动作块级别的信用分配，而无需辅助评估器。关键洞察在于，到达相应物理状态的轨迹展开可以互为参照：它们的终端结果为评估局部进展提供了证据。我们提出了基于物理关系的回合信用推断方法（PRICE），包含两个组成部分：（i）物理关系图，在相应的动作块边界汇集当前和历史结果以估计成功潜力；以及（ii）置信门控信用分配，利用这些潜力的变化来细化轨迹级监督。我们的分析将预言机潜力变化与终端成功目标联系起来，并为结果无关的证据池提供了有限样本方向性界。独立延续测试表明，PRICE保留的信用与局部进展一致，而在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实机器人上的实验则证明了相较于基于结果的基线方法，任务成功率有所提高且学习速度更快。

title: DODGER: Safety-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation Among Dynamic Obstacles
summary: Robots operating in human-centered environments must safely navigate among multiple dynamic obstacles to avoid collisions with people and surrounding infrastructure. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide an effective mechanism for safety filtering, and recent CBF-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods embed such safety information into learned policies. However, executing only safety-filtered actions during training can restrict policy exploration, a limitation that becomes particularly consequential in dynamic scenes where safety depends on relative robot-obstacle motion. We propose DODGER, a safety-guided RL framework that directly executes policy-generated actions to drive training rollouts while using CBF-filtered references and constraint violations to shape the policy toward collision-avoidance behavior. We evaluate DODGER through a Dubins-car safety analysis and demonstrate goal-directed navigation among multiple dynamic obstacles in full-order humanoid simulation and real-world humanoid experiments using LiDAR-based perception, without a runtime safety filter.
tldr: DODGER presents a safety-guided reinforcement learning framework for robot navigation among dynamic obstacles, using CBF-filtered references and constraint violations to shape policy learning without a runtime safety filter, validated in humanoid simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: DODGER 提出了一种安全引导的强化学习框架，用于在动态障碍物中进行机器人导航，利用控制障碍函数过滤的参考和约束违反来塑造策略学习，无需运行时安全过滤器，并在人形机器人的仿真和真实实验中验证。
summary_zh: 在以人为中心的环境中运行的机器人必须在多个动态障碍物之间安全导航，以避免与人员及周边基础设施发生碰撞。控制障碍函数（CBFs）为安全过滤提供了一种有效机制，而近期基于CBF的强化学习（RL）方法将此类安全信息嵌入到学习策略中。然而，在训练过程中仅执行经过安全过滤的动作可能会限制策略的探索，这一局限在动态场景中尤为凸显，因为此类场景下的安全性取决于机器人与障碍物之间的相对运动。我们提出DODGER，一种安全引导的强化学习框架，该框架直接执行策略生成的动作以驱动训练轨迹，同时利用CBF过滤的参考信号和约束违例情况来引导策略形成避碰行为。我们通过Dubins车辆安全性分析对DODGER进行了评估，并在全阶人形机器人仿真及基于LiDAR感知的真实世界人形机器人实验中，展示了其在多个动态障碍物环境中的目标导向导航能力，且无需运行时安全过滤器。

title: Locomotion-Grounded Humanoid Soccer: Task-Gated Reinforcement Learning of a Multi-Directional Kicking Library
summary: Recent humanoid soccer systems make motion tracking the substrate and derive locomotion from it, typically by steering a motion-reference anchor toward the ball. This yields strong shooting results, but locomotion is trained only on the narrow, deterministic command distribution ball approach induces, never evaluated as a capability in its own right. We invert the stack: a general, command-conditioned locomotion policy is trained first as the substrate, and N motion-guided kicking skills are added on top as task-gated layers, so the reachable gait space is set by the locomotion curriculum rather than any reference clip. Because every skill starts from and returns to this same commandable state, locomotion also becomes a composition hub (O(N) transitions rather than O(N^2)), and post-strike stabilisation is handed back to the trained controller rather than scripted per clip. We instantiate this on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 with seven retargeted kicking skills spanning 259.5 degrees of nominal aim direction, including lateral, rearward and weak-foot strikes a single forward-facing reference cannot express, and report shooting accuracy alongside command-tracking, terrain and push-recovery results with the full skill library attached, an axis prior humanoid soccer systems do not report. The library is validated on hardware across forward, lateral, rearward and commanded approaches.
tldr: The paper inverts the typical humanoid soccer pipeline by training a command-conditioned locomotion policy first, then adding a library of task-gated kicking skills, enabling multi-directional kicks and improved composition on a Unitree G1.
tldr_zh: 该论文颠倒了典型的人形足球流程，先训练命令条件下的运动策略，再添加任务门控的踢球技能库，从而在Unitree G1上实现多方向踢球并改善组合能力。
summary_zh: 近期的仿人足球系统将运动跟踪作为基础，并由此推导出动行为，通常通过将运动参考锚点引导至足球方向来实现。这种方法取得了良好的射门效果，但动策略仅针对足球接近所引发的狭窄、确定性指令分布进行训练，从未将其作为一项独立能力加以评估。我们反转了这一架构：首先训练一个通用的、基于指令条件的动策略作为基础层，然后在其上添加N个由运动引导的踢球技能作为任务门控层，从而使得可达步态空间由动课程设定，而非任何参考片段。由于每个技能都从这一可指令状态出发并最终返回该状态，动策略同时成为组合枢纽（O(N)次转换而非O(N^2)），且击球后的稳定控制交由已训练控制器处理，而非针对每个片段进行脚本化设定。我们在具有29个自由度的Unitree G1上实现了该系统，包含七个重定向踢球技能，覆盖259.5度的标称瞄准方向，包括侧向、后方及弱脚击球——这些是单一前向参考无法表达的，并报告了射门精度以及附带完整技能库的指令跟踪、地形适应和推力恢复结果——这一维度的评估是先前仿人足球系统所未涉及的。该技能库在前向、侧向、后方及指令化接近方式下均通过了硬件验证。

title: Path-Following Control and Terramechanics Analysis for Planetary Rovers Under Wheel-to-Wheel Traction Asymmetry
summary: This paper proposes a control strategy for path following that is model-free and relies solely on deceleration for skid-steering planetary rovers navigating deformable loose terrain under continuously imposed traction asymmetry. While conventional controllers that are based on kinematics frequently cause slip-sinkage entrapment by accelerating the wheels during path correction, the proposed approach prevents this failure by setting an upper limit on the maximum commanded velocity. Heading correction is achieved solely through the selective deceleration of the outer wheels, which are located on the outside of the turn, driving them into a negative slip regime to act as a mechanical anchor. The system was evaluated using the four-wheel independent-drive rover EX1 under an asymmetric wheel configuration with different left and right grouser heights that induces significant deviations from the path. Experimental results demonstrate that this deceleration-only control successfully suppresses accumulated lateral drift across various velocity regimes up to 0.7 m/s without causing sinkage. Crucially, direct force measurements from onboard multi-axis sensors provide important empirical evidence of the underlying terramechanics, proving that the targeted deceleration establishes dynamic load equalization across the chassis and completely restores the native thrust capability of the opposite driving wheel.
tldr: This paper proposes a model-free, deceleration-only path-following control strategy for skid-steering planetary rovers on deformable terrain, which avoids slip-sinkage and is validated with real rover experiments and force measurements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于纯减速的模型无关路径跟踪控制策略，用于在可变形地形上的滑移转向行星车，避免打滑下陷，并通过真实车辆实验和力测量验证。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种无模型、仅依赖减速实现路径跟踪的控制策略，用于在持续施加牵引力不对称条件下、于可变形松散地形上行驶的滑移转向行星巡视器。传统基于运动学的控制器在路径修正过程中通常通过加速车轮来纠偏，这常常导致滑移-下陷耦合失效；而所提方法通过对最大指令速度设置上限来避免此类失效。航向修正完全依靠对转向外侧车轮的选择性减速实现，使外侧车轮进入负滑移状态，充当机械锚点。该系统在四轮独立驱动巡视器EX1上进行了评估，采用左右履齿高度不同的不对称车轮配置，以诱发显著的路径偏离。实验结果表明，这种仅减速控制策略在高达0.7 m/s的各种速度区间内均能有效抑制累积横向漂移，且不会引起下陷。至关重要的是，来自车载多轴传感器的直接力测量为底层地面力学提供了重要的实验证据，证明定向减速能够在底盘上建立动态载荷均衡，并完全恢复对侧驱动轮的固有推力能力。

title: IndoorBEV: A Lightweight Real-Time LiDAR BEV Perception System for Indoor Mobile Robots
summary: Efficient indoor LiDAR perception is challenging because mobile robots must understand cluttered three-dimensional environments under strict latency and memory constraints. Existing point-based and voxel-based methods often incur substantial computational overhead, whereas conventional bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations improve efficiency at the cost of discarding vertical geometric information. We present IndoorBEV, a lightweight LiDAR perception framework that mitigates this tradeoff through a height-aware BEV representation and geometry-conditioned feature fusion. IndoorBEV summarizes the vertical point distribution in each BEV cell using statistical height features and multi-frequency height encoding, allowing informative three-dimensional cues to be processed efficiently by two-dimensional convolutions. A lightweight encoder then integrates complementary geometric features with multi-scale local representations and compact global scene context. Decoupled dense prediction heads jointly produce semantic BEV maps and oriented object bounding boxes. IndoorBEV contains only 0.6M parameters and requires 2.3 MB of model storage. On an NVIDIA AGX Orin, it uses 21.52 MB of GPU memory per inference and achieves a mean latency of 169.6 ms under a 200 ms perception deadline, with a deadline miss ratio of 1.8\%. Evaluations on simulated scenes, real-world robot scans, and an open-source indoor point-cloud dataset demonstrate a favorable tradeoff among perception accuracy, latency, and memory consumption. These results indicate that explicitly encoding vertical geometry within a compact BEV representation provides an effective approach to resource-efficient indoor LiDAR perception.
tldr: IndoorBEV presents a lightweight LiDAR perception framework using a height-aware BEV representation and geometry-conditioned feature fusion to achieve efficient semantic mapping and object detection for indoor mobile robots under strict latency and memory constraints.
tldr_zh: IndoorBEV 提出了一种轻量级 LiDAR 感知框架，通过高度感知的 BEV 表示和几何条件特征融合，在严格的延迟和内存限制下实现高效的室内移动机器人语义地图构建和物体检测。
summary_zh: 高效室内激光雷达感知颇具挑战性，因为移动机器人必须在严格的延迟和内存限制下理解杂乱的三维环境。现有的基于点云和基于体素的方法往往带来较高的计算开销，而传统的鸟瞰图表示虽然提升了效率，却以丢失垂直几何信息为代价。我们提出了IndoorBEV，一种轻量级激光雷达感知框架，通过高度感知的鸟瞰图表示和几何条件特征融合来缓解这一权衡。IndoorBEV利用统计高度特征和多频高度编码对每个鸟瞰图单元内的垂直点分布进行概括，使得有信息量的三维线索能够通过二维卷积高效处理。随后，一个轻量级编码器将互补的几何特征与多尺度局部表示及紧凑的全局场景上下文相融合。解耦的密集预测头联合生成语义鸟瞰图和面向目标的定向包围框。IndoorBEV仅包含0.6M参数，模型存储仅需2.3 MB。在NVIDIA AGX Orin上，单次推理仅占用21.52 MB GPU内存，在200毫秒感知时限内平均延迟为169.6毫秒，超时率为1.8%。在仿真场景、真实机器人扫描以及开源室内点云数据集上的评估表明，该方法在感知精度、延迟和内存消耗之间实现了良好的权衡。这些结果表明，在紧凑的鸟瞰图表示中显式编码垂直几何信息，为资源高效的室内激光雷达感知提供了一条有效路径。

title: TERRA: Terrain-Aware Reconstruction, Retargeting and Control for Musculoskeletal Locomotion
summary: Recent advances in musculoskeletal modeling and reinforcement learning have enabled muscle-actuated agents to reproduce increasingly complex human motions. Yet these capabilities remain largely confined to flat ground, in part because motion datasets rarely include aligned terrain geometry and because retargeting terrain interactions to complex musculoskeletal bodies is challenging. We present TERRA, an end-to-end pipeline for terrain-aware retargeting and control of musculoskeletal locomotion. From kinematic trajectories alone, TERRA combines terrain priors, estimated contacts, and negative free-space evidence to recover task-relevant support geometry. TERRA further considers anatomical, tendon-continuity, and contact constraints during retargeting. Using the resulting motion-terrain pairs from five datasets, we successfully train a single muscle-actuated control policy on 9.4 hours of diverse locomotion. Across reconstruction, retargeting, and held-out tracking benchmarks, TERRA improves terrain accuracy, sharply reduces anatomical and interaction violations, and achieves the highest observed completion rate over supported terrain families. Overall, TERRA provides a practical route from scene-less motion data to muscle-actuated locomotion over diverse non-flat terrain. Project website: https://cnai.epfl.ch/terra/
tldr: TERRA is an end-to-end pipeline that reconstructs terrain geometry from kinematic motion data, retargets motions to musculoskeletal bodies with anatomical and contact constraints, and trains a single muscle-actuated control policy for diverse non-flat terrain locomotion.
tldr_zh: TERRA 是一个端到端流水线，从运动学数据重建地形几何，在解剖学和接触约束下将动作重定向到肌肉骨骼模型，并训练统一的肌肉驱动控制策略以在多种非平坦地形上运动。
summary_zh: 近期在肌肉骨骼建模和强化学习方面的进展，使得肌肉驱动的主体能够再现越来越复杂的人类运动。然而，这些能力在很大程度上仍局限于平坦地面，部分原因在于运动数据集很少包含对齐的地形几何信息，并且将地形交互重新定位到复杂的肌肉骨骼体上具有挑战性。我们提出了TERRA，一个用于地形感知重定向和肌肉骨骼运动控制的端到端流程。仅从运动学轨迹出发，TERRA结合地形先验、估计接触和负自由空间证据，恢复任务相关的支撑几何形状。TERRA在重定向过程中进一步考虑解剖学、肌腱连续性和接触约束。利用来自五个数据集的运动-地形配对，我们成功地在9.4小时的多样化运动数据上训练了一个单一的肌肉驱动控制策略。在重建、重定向和留出跟踪基准测试中，TERRA提高了地形精度，显著减少了解剖学和交互违规，并在所支持的地形类别中取得了最高的观察完成率。总体而言，TERRA为从无场景运动数据到多样化非平坦地形上的肌肉驱动运动提供了一条实用路径。项目网站：https://cnai.epfl.ch/terra/

title: Yggdrasil: a Layer-First 3D Scene Graph for Real-Time Querying
summary:
Robotic agents use 3D scene graphs (3DSG) to perform tasks ranging from scene understanding to scene interaction. Although an extensive body of work addresses scene graph generation, little attention has been paid to optimizing the graph for consumption, which leaves state-of-the-art perception pipelines to work around their own scene graph and to pay a latency cost that does not fit the real-time budget a perception loop runs on.
  We present Yggdrasil, the first 3D scene graph designed to be efficient for both generation and consumption: a layer-first hierarchical graph built from generic nodes, edges, and layers, which expresses the representations existing pipelines already produce, indoor or outdoor, flat or hierarchical, while natively answering the positional and semantic queries downstream tasks issue.
  Against a published DSG baseline, Yggdrasil answers queries up to $121\times$ faster, and every query we measure falls between 2 and 127 microseconds, three to five orders of magnitude inside the 200 microsecond keyframe budget a 3DSG consumer lives in, on both a workstation and embedded class device. We integrate Yggdrasil into three published pipelines spanning human trajectory prediction, object-goal navigation, and human-aware motion planning, where it removes up to 99% of the time each spends on its scene graph. The implementation, benchmark harness, and all three integrations are available online.
tldr: Yggdrasil presents a layer-first 3D scene graph optimized for efficient generation and consumption, enabling real-time querying for robotic pipelines. It achieves up to 121x faster query responses than baselines and integrates into multiple robotics applications, significantly reducing scene graph processing time.
tldr_zh: Yggdrasil 提出了一种分层优先的3D场景图，针对生成和消费效率进行优化，支持机器人流程的实时查询。其查询响应速度比基线快121倍，并集成到多个机器人应用中，大幅减少了场景图处理时间。
summary_zh:
机器人智能体使用三维场景图（3DSG）来执行从场景理解到场景交互的各种任务。尽管已有大量工作致力于场景图的生成，但在优化场景图以供消费使用方面却鲜有关注，这导致最先进的感知流水线不得不绕开自身的场景图工作，并付出与感知循环实时预算不相匹配的延迟成本。

我们提出了Yggdrasil，这是首个旨在同时实现高效生成与高效消费的三维场景图：一种基于通用节点、边和层构建的层优先分层图，能够表达现有流水线已经生成的各类表示——无论是室内还是室外、平面还是分层结构——同时原生地响应下游任务所提出的位置与语义查询。

与已发表的DSG基线相比，Yggdrasil的查询响应速度快了最多\(121\times\)，我们测得的所有查询耗时均介于2至127微秒之间，比3DSG消费端所处的200微秒关键帧预算快了三到五个数量级——无论是在工作站还是嵌入式设备上均是如此。我们将Yggdrasil集成到了三个已发表的流水线中，涵盖人类轨迹预测、目标导向导航和感知人类运动规划，在这些系统中它消除了各自花费在场景图上最多99%的时间。相关实现、基准测试工具以及全部三个集成均已在线上公开。

title: HIGS: Hierarchical Implicit Grids for Joint Geometric and Semantic Scene Understanding
summary: Neural implicit representations have had a significant impact on scene reconstruction by enabling robots to build continuous, differentiable, and high-fidelity 3D maps. Most existing works focus on geometric reconstruction and lack semantic information for high-level spatial understanding and task planning. Also, as the scale and complexity of the environment increase, neural representations face the challenge of maintaining computational efficiency in back-end optimization. To resolve these two challenges, we introduce a hierarchical neural field that leverages multiresolution submaps to achieve an efficient and scalable implicit representation, and a unified query and decoding mechanism to support both geometric and semantic features. More specifically, the learnable map features can be converted to the output with the query and decoding process for both training and inference. For large-scale representation, we decompose a scene into overlapping submaps and do hierarchical optimization within each local submap, thus enabling scalable computation. To further improve efficiency, we design feature encoders that predict initial hierarchical grid features to substantially reduce the time needed to optimize the submap features from scratch. To correct estimation drift among submaps, we align and fuse them entirely within the implicit feature space, leading to substantial acceleration by avoiding the need to decode the final output. Building upon this efficient hierarchical representation, we embed both geometric features and vision-language latent features into the map, and demonstrate it on both Signed Distance Field (SDF) construction and open-vocabulary object grounding. Our approach significantly improves computation and memory efficiency, maintains high estimation accuracy, and endows the robot with spatial awareness on large-scale real-world benchmarks.
tldr: HIGS introduces a hierarchical neural field using multiresolution submaps for efficient joint geometric and semantic scene understanding in large-scale environments, leveraging vision-language features for open-vocabulary grounding and SDF construction.
tldr_zh: HIGS 提出了一种利用多分辨率子图的分层神经场，用于大规模环境下的高效几何与语义联合场景理解，并结合视觉-语言特征实现开放词汇目标定位和 SDF 构建。
summary_zh: 神经隐式表示通过使机器人能够构建连续、可微分且高保真的三维地图，对场景重建产生了显著影响。现有的大多数工作侧重于几何重建，缺乏用于高层次空间理解和任务规划的语义信息。此外，随着环境规模和复杂性的增加，神经表示在后端优化中面临保持计算效率的挑战。为解决这两个挑战，我们引入了一种分层神经场，利用多分辨率子地图实现高效且可扩展的隐式表示，并采用统一的查询与解码机制来同时支持几何特征和语义特征。具体而言，可学习的映射特征可通过查询和解码过程转换为输出，适用于训练和推理阶段。对于大规模表示，我们将场景分解为重叠的子地图，并在每个局部子地图内进行分层优化，从而实现可扩展的计算。为进一步提高效率，我们设计了特征编码器，用于预测初始的分层网格特征，大幅减少从零开始优化子地图特征所需的时间。为了校正子地图之间的估计漂移，我们完全在隐式特征空间中对它们进行对齐和融合，通过避免解码最终输出来实现显著的加速。基于这种高效的分层表示，我们将几何特征和视觉-语言潜在特征嵌入到地图中，并在有符号距离场（SDF）构建和开放词汇对象定位任务上进行了验证。我们的方法显著提高了计算和内存效率，保持了较高的估计精度，并使机器人在大规模真实世界基准测试中具备空间感知能力。

title: Dense Temporal Motion Retargeting for Legged Robots
summary: Legged robots can learn expressive whole-body skills from the motions of humans and animals. Due to the morphology gap between the source and the robot, however, the motion must be tailored to the dynamic properties of the robot. In particular, dynamic motions such as a jump require careful adjustment, since their timing and control are interdependent. We propose dense temporal motion retargeting (DTMR), which jointly optimizes timing and control within a single optimization, where dense means that the timing is adjusted for every control step. This dense formulation enables DTMR to deform only the parts of the motion that need a change in timing. The problem is solved with sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) in parallel on a GPU. We evaluate DTMR against baselines on two hours of human motion with four humanoid robots, where the results show that DTMR outperforms baseline methods, particularly on dynamic motions. We also show that allowing more temporal deformation yields more precise retargeting. We further compare DTMR with a baseline that optimizes the temporal dimension, where the result shows that DTMR retargets more precisely under the same deformation budget while being ~19x faster. Lastly, policies trained on our references transfer to a real humanoid robot.
tldr: DTMR proposes a dense temporal motion retargeting method that jointly optimizes timing and control via sampling-based MPC on GPU, enabling legged robots to accurately execute dynamic human motions with real-robot transfer.
tldr_zh: DTMR 提出一种密集时间运动重定向方法，通过 GPU 上的采样 MPC 联合优化时序和控制，使足式机器人能精确执行动态人体动作并迁移到真实机器人。
summary_zh: 腿式机器人能够从人类和动物的动作中学习富有表现力的全身技能。然而，由于源对象与机器人之间存在形态差异，运动必须根据机器人的动力学特性进行适配调整。尤其是跳跃等动态动作，由于其时序与控制相互依存，需要仔细调整。我们提出了稠密时间运动重定向（DTMR）方法，该方法在单一优化过程中联合优化时序与控制，其中“稠密”意味着对每个控制步的时序进行调整。这种稠密公式使得DTMR能够仅对运动中需要改变时序的部分进行变形。该问题通过基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）在GPU上并行求解。我们使用两小时的人类运动数据及四款人形机器人，将DTMR与基线方法进行了评估，结果表明DTMR在动态动作上尤其优于基线方法。我们还展示了允许更多的时间变形能够实现更精确的重定向。我们进一步将DTMR与一个优化时间维度的基线方法进行比较，结果显示，在相同的变形预算下，DTMR的重定向精度更高，且速度约快19倍。最后，基于我们参考轨迹训练的策略成功迁移到了真实的人形机器人上。

title: Drone Soccer: Learning to Manipulate with Multicopter Downwash
summary: Although multicopter drones are traditionally designed for "perception-only" tasks, like mapping and exploration, recent work has sought to develop Unmanned Aerial Manipulators (UAMs) to solve mobile manipulation tasks. Aerial manipulation performance can be impacted by "downwash," the airflow produced by propellers, but current state-of-the-art UAMs either ignore downwash or treat it as a disturbance. Instead, is it possible to actively use downwash as a tool during manipulation? We design a drone soccer task to explore the feasibility of downwash-based manipulation. Specifically, we develop a simplified downwash dynamics model which we use to train an RL policy to dribble a soccer ball. We further demonstrate that our policy transfers to real world deployment. This work provides key insights into novel manipulation capabilities for multicopters.
tldr: This paper introduces a drone soccer task where a multicopter learns to dribble a ball using its downwash, modeling the airflow and training an RL policy that transfers to real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个无人机足球任务，无人机利用其下洗气流学习运球，通过建立简化的下洗动力学模型并训练RL策略，实现了向真实世界的迁移。
summary_zh: 尽管多旋翼无人机传统上被设计用于“仅感知”任务，如地图绘制和探索，但近期的研究已致力于开发无人机空中机械臂（UAMs）来解决移动操作任务。空中操作性能可能受到“下洗气流”（即螺旋桨产生的气流）的影响，然而当前最先进的UAMs要么忽略下洗气流，要么将其视为干扰因素。那么，我们能否在操作过程中主动利用下洗气流作为一种工具呢？我们设计了一项无人机足球任务，以探索基于下洗气流操作的可行性。具体而言，我们开发了一个简化的下洗气流动力学模型，并利用该模型训练了一个强化学习（RL）策略来实现对足球的运球。我们进一步证明，该策略能够成功迁移至实际场景中的应用。这项工作为多旋翼无人机的新型操作能力提供了关键见解。

title: Onboard Vision and MPC Navigation for Underwater Robots: An Open BlueROV2 Platform for Multi-Robot Experiments & Docking
summary: Autonomous underwater robots require robust perception, estimation and control to operate in confined environments. This paper presents an open-source BlueROV2 platform combining onboard vision with nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) for autonomous navigation and docking. The platform integrates an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX and an Intel RealSense D435i stereo camera in a modular pressure housing. Underwater-calibrated stereo depth and realtime object detection provide relative position measurements of nearby BlueROV2 vehicles in the camera and body frames. A quaternion-based estimator fuses external pose and inertial measurements, while an NMPC controller based on a nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom model tracks planned navigation and docking trajectories. To support reproducible development, we also provide open-source physics-based PX4 SITL and Gazebo environments, multi-robot simulation tools and a lowcost physical docking station. Experiments evaluate underwater perception, onboard computational performance, state estimation, trajectory tracking and autonomous docking.
tldr: This paper presents an open-source BlueROV2 platform integrating onboard vision with nonlinear MPC for autonomous navigation and docking, including multi-robot simulation and physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个开源的BlueROV2平台，将机载视觉与非线性MPC相结合，用于自主导航和对接，并包含多机器人仿真和物理实验。
summary_zh: 自主水下机器人在受限环境中作业时，需要具备稳健的感知、估计与控制能力。本文介绍了一个开源BlueROV2平台，该平台将机载视觉与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）相结合，用于实现自主导航与对接。该平台在模块化耐压壳体内集成了NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX和Intel RealSense D435i立体相机。经过水下标定的立体深度测量与实时目标检测，可提供附近BlueROV2航行器在相机坐标系和机体坐标系下的相对位置测量值。基于四元数的估计器融合了外部位姿与惯性测量数据，而基于非线性六自由度模型的NMPC控制器则负责跟踪规划的导航与对接轨迹。为支持可复现的开发，我们还提供了基于物理模型的开源PX4 SITL与Gazebo仿真环境、多机器人仿真工具，以及低成本的物理对接站。实验评估覆盖了水下感知、机载计算性能、状态估计、轨迹跟踪及自主对接等方面。

title: What to Attend, What to Keep: Skill-Conditioned Visuotactile Representation with Progress-Guided Event Memory
summary: Robotic manipulation integrates vision, touch, and language, whose importance shifts across stages: vision guides reaching, while touch, through its evolution over time, decides grasping, alignment, and contact. Yet existing multi-modal manipulation policies typically use fixed temporal contexts and fusion strategies, despite shifts in what each modality contributes across different skills. We study how vision and touch should be combined at the level of primitive skills, asking what each skill needs from each sensor, and propose a skill-conditioned representation in which the queried skill conditions fusion over modality-specific short-term observation tokens while attending to a sparse event memory that retains terminal observations from the last $K$ executed skills. Evaluated by skill progress estimation on three contact-rich tasks, it reduces slip-detection delay by 87% against fine-tuned SOTA progress models, twist-completion delay by 67.5% against a vision-only ablation, and progress error on a blind search task by 92% through sparse event memory. Gains concentrate exactly where completion is defined by contact or task history. More broadly, our results suggest that observation formation not only policy architecture is a central challenge in multi-modal representation. Project Website: http://what-to-attend-what-to-keep.github.io/
tldr: The paper proposes a skill-conditioned visuotactile representation with progress-guided event memory for contact-rich robotic manipulation, adaptively fusing vision and touch based on the skill and using sparse memory of terminal observations to improve progress estimation and reduce delays.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种技能条件化的视觉触觉表示与进度引导事件记忆，用于接触丰富的机器人操作，根据技能自适应融合视觉和触觉，并利用稀疏的终止观测记忆改善进度估计并减少延迟。
summary_zh: 机器人操作整合了视觉、触觉与语言，其重要性在不同阶段有所转变：视觉引导物体接近，而触觉则通过其随时间的变化，决定抓取、对准与接触。然而，现有的多模态操作策略通常采用固定的时间上下文和融合策略，尽管不同技能中各模态的贡献会发生变化。我们研究了在原始技能层面上视觉与触觉应如何结合，探究每个技能对每种传感器的需求，并提出了一种技能条件化表示，其中查询到的技能条件作用于模态特定的短期观测标记的融合，同时关注一个稀疏事件记忆，该记忆保留最近执行过的K个技能的终态观测。通过对三项接触密集型任务的技能进度评估，该方法相较于微调后的最优进度模型，将滑动检测延迟降低了87%；相较于仅依赖视觉的消融模型，将扭转完成延迟降低了67.5%；通过稀疏事件记忆，在盲搜索任务中将进度误差降低了92%。这些增益恰好集中在由接触或任务历史定义完成度的环节。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，观测的形成方式——而不仅仅是策略架构——是多模态表示中的核心挑战。项目网站：http://what-to-attend-what-to-keep.github.io/

title: CADeT: Causal-Aware Deformation Transmission for Indirect Robotic Manipulation of Soft Tissue
summary: Indirect manipulation of deep-seated deformable anatomy inaccessible to the robot is challenging in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS) because intervening tissues spatially filter deformation transmission. Passive observations can be ambiguous because the Decoupled and Blocked modes may produce similar motion responses. We propose CADeT, a causal-aware deformation transmission framework that integrates structural causal model (SCM) with active sensing to infer a latent transmission mode and estimate a state-dependent adhesion Jacobian online. During normal manipulation, control actions update the mode belief; when ambiguity persists, an additional probing action is selected to improve mode distinguishability. The mode belief and learned Jacobian are incorporated into a belief-aware model predictive controller for indirect target-shape control. Validation in simulation and on the da Vinci research kit (dVRK), using phantom and ex vivo porcine tissues, shows higher mode-identification accuracy and faster shape-error convergence than the evaluated model-free and model-based baselines. These results show that active sensing improves mode identification and indirect deformation control under the evaluated conditions.
tldr: CADeT introduces a causal-aware deformation transmission framework that integrates an SCM with active probing to identify latent transmission modes and estimate a state-dependent adhesion Jacobian, enabling belief-aware model predictive control for indirect soft-tissue manipulation in RAMIS. Validation on a dVRK with phantoms and ex vivo tissue shows improved mode identification and shape-error convergence.
tldr_zh: CADeT提出了一种因果感知的变形传递框架，结合结构因果模型与主动探测来识别潜在传递模式并在线估计状态相关的粘附雅可比，从而在机器人辅助微创手术中实现间接软组织形变的信念感知模型预测控制。在dVRK上的仿体和离体猪组织实验中验证了更高的模式识别精度和更快的形状误差收敛。
summary_zh: 间接操控机器人无法触及的深层可变形解剖结构，在机器人辅助微创手术（RAMIS）中具有挑战性，因为中间组织会在空间上对形变传递进行滤波。被动观测可能具有模糊性，因为解耦模式和阻塞模式可能产生相似的运动响应。我们提出CADeT，一种因果感知的形变传递框架，将结构因果模型（SCM）与主动感知相结合，以推断潜在的传递模式并在线估计与状态相关的粘附雅可比矩阵。在正常操作过程中，控制动作更新模式置信度；当模糊性持续存在时，选择额外的探测动作以提高模式可区分性。将模式置信度和学习到的雅可比矩阵融入基于置信度的模型预测控制器，以实现间接目标形状控制。在仿真和达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）上，使用体模和离体猪组织进行验证，结果显示，与所评估的无模型和基于模型的基线方法相比，所提方法具有更高的模式识别准确率和更快的形状误差收敛速度。这些结果表明，在所评估的条件下，主动感知能够提高模式识别能力和间接形变控制性能。

title: Draft: A Parametric Tool for Robot Design Exploration
summary: Robot performance is often limited by the cost of iterating on morphology and control together, since every computer-aided design (CAD) change has to be carried into a simulation-ready model before control work begins. Co-design methods attempt to close this gap, but each uses a model generator written for a single platform or lack the use of real-world data to suggest that designs are plausible. We present Draft, a parametric generation tool whose generalized engine compiles any parametric tree of serial chains into a simulation-ready MJCF model, without CAD. It allows engineers to explore design tradeoffs through easily adjustable models and evaluate how changes influence controller performance. Draft grounds the free parameters of each design using trends fitted to a survey of $114$ actuators and $49$ published robot descriptions, so that a generated robot is anchored to real-world hardware. We validate those trends wholistically by building twins of four off-the-shelf robots, whose masses agree to $1.10\times$ geometric mean fold error. Finally, we demonstrate how Draft exposes design tradeoffs by evaluating three quadrupeds through a two-stage reinforcement learning curriculum.
tldr: Draft is a parametric tool that generates MuJoCo models of serial-chain robots from a parametric tree without CAD, grounding free parameters using trends from real actuators and robot descriptions, and demonstrates design tradeoffs via RL-evaluated quadrupeds.
tldr_zh: Draft 是一个参数化工具，可从参数树直接生成串链机器人的 MuJoCo 模型，无需 CAD，并利用真实执行器和机器人描述的趋势约束自由参数，通过四足机器人的强化学习评估展示设计权衡。
summary_zh: 机器人性能往往受制于形态与控制协同迭代的成本，因为每次计算机辅助设计（CAD）变更都必须在控制工作开始前转化为可用于仿真的模型。协同设计方法试图弥合这一差距，但每种方法都依赖于为单一平台编写的模型生成器，或缺乏利用真实世界数据来验证设计合理性的能力。我们提出Draft——一种参数化生成工具，其通用引擎可将任意串联链参数化树直接编译为可用于仿真的MJCF模型，无需CAD。该工具使工程师能够通过易于调整的模型探索设计权衡，并评估变更对控制器性能的影响。Draft基于对114个执行器和49个已发表机器人描述数据的趋势拟合，为每个设计的自由参数提供依据，从而确保生成的机器人锚定于真实硬件。我们通过构建四款现成机器人的孪生模型进行整体验证，其质量与几何平均倍数误差一致（1.10倍）。最后，我们通过两阶段强化学习课程评估三种四足机器人，展示了Draft如何揭示设计权衡。

title: Memorize, Adapt, Ignore: Diagnosing Robot Learning Mechanisms under Training Data Variation
summary: Training data variation, whether through designing a domain randomization (DR) scheme in simulation or curating demonstrations for imitation learning, is a primary lever for improving the robustness of robotic manipulation policies. Yet its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood, and practitioners typically select randomization parameters through expensive trial and error. We investigate these mechanisms through a series of case studies, randomizing object size, color, and type as well as scene lighting and linguistic prompts across settings including pick-and-place RL in ManiSkill and fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) models on LIBERO and RoboTwin. We examine both model behavior and internal representations, using the empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) as our primary diagnostic tool. We show that the NTK distinguishes a shift in the internal learning mechanism from \textit{memorizing} different situations with insufficient variation (e.g.\ learning what to do for a large cube, and what to do for a small cube) to \textit{adapting} to the situation at hand with sufficient variation. An NTK-based signal-to-noise ratio also helps distinguish when policies have learned to \emph{ignore} task-irrelevant factors (e.g.\ treating blue and red cubes identically, instead of learning a blue sub-policy and a red sub-policy). We use these diagnostics to develop practical guidance for designing DR schemes, selecting models, and detecting shortcut learning. We further compare different kinds of representations and validate our findings with real-world hardware experiments using ACT-based imitation learning.
tldr: This paper uses the empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) as a diagnostic to characterize how robot manipulation policies memorize, adapt, or ignore training data variations, providing practical guidance for domain randomization and shortcut detection, validated with real-world ACT experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文利用经验神经正切核（NTK）作为诊断工具，刻画机器人操作策略在训练数据变化下是记忆、适应还是忽略，为域随机化设计和捷径学习检测提供实用指导，并通过真实ACT实验验证。
summary_zh: 训练数据的变化性——无论是通过在仿真中设计域随机化（DR）方案，还是为模仿学习整理示范数据——都是提升机器人操控策略鲁棒性的主要手段。然而，其内在机制仍未被充分理解，从业者通常需要通过代价高昂的试错过程来选择随机化参数。我们通过一系列案例研究来探究这些机制，在多种设置中对物体大小、颜色和类型以及场景光照和语言提示进行随机化，涵盖ManiSkill中的抓取-放置强化学习以及基于LIBERO和RoboTwin的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型微调。我们同时考察模型行为与内部表征，并以经验神经正切核（NTK）作为主要诊断工具。我们表明，NTK能够区分内部学习机制从“记忆”不同情境但变化不足（例如，学习对大立方体该如何操作、对小立方体又该如何操作）向“适应”当前情境且变化充分（即能够根据手头情境灵活调整）的转变。基于NTK的信噪比还有助于判断策略是否学会了“忽略”任务无关因素（例如，将蓝色和红色立方体同等对待，而非分别学习蓝色子策略和红色子策略）。我们利用这些诊断方法，为设计DR方案、选择模型以及检测捷径学习提供了实用指导。我们进一步比较了不同类型的表征，并通过基于ACT的模仿学习在实际机器人硬件实验中验证了我们的发现。

title: GestAdapt: Workspace-Conditioned Co-Speech Gesture Generation for Humanoid Robots
summary: Co-speech gestures for robots must adapt not only to speech and embodiment, but also to the workspace available for performing the motion. Since the same speech can be accompanied by different gestures, a robot can respond to workspace constraints, e.g., gestures for speech next to a wall. In these scenarios, the robot should gesture in a suitable motion rather than simply correcting an unconstrained one. To achieve this goal, we present GestAdapt, a workspace-conditioned framework that conditions co-speech gesture generation on a prescribed wrist workspace. The GestAdapt framework learns from six complementary co-speech corpora through a shared motion representation and supports retargeting to different robot embodiments. Quantitative evaluation shows that generated motions remain close to the real-motion distribution while respecting the workspace. In a user study, gestures generated under modified workspace constraints receive a mean quality score of 3.24/5, above our no-workspace variant (2.43/5) and below the reference motions (3.68/5). In a real robot evaluation, all compared motions are retargeted to the Reachy2 humanoid robot under identical workspace constraints. Motions generated with our framework rank first in 69.7\% of comparisons, higher than our no-workspace variant baseline and retargeted ground-truth motions constrained afterward. Overall, the results support adapting gestures to the available workspace during generation, rather than modifying unconstrained trajectories afterward to satisfy workspace constraints, potentially compromising gesture naturalness.
tldr: This paper presents GestAdapt, a workspace-conditioned co-speech gesture generation framework for humanoid robots that adapts gestures to available workspace constraints during generation, showing improved naturalness and user preference over post-hoc constrained baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出GestAdapt，一种面向人形机器人的工作空间条件共语手势生成框架，在生成阶段即适配可用工作空间的约束，相比事后约束的基线方法在自然度和用户偏好上更优。
summary_zh: 机器人伴随言语的共语手势不仅要适应言语和具身形态，还必须适应执行动作时可用的工作空间。由于相同的言语可以伴随不同的手势，机器人能够响应工作空间约束，例如在墙壁旁进行言语时的手势。在这些场景中，机器人应采用合适的动作进行手势表达，而非简单地对无约束手势进行修正。为实现这一目标，我们提出了GestAdapt，一种以工作空间为条件的框架，该框架在指定的腕部工作空间条件下生成共语手势。GestAdapt框架通过共享运动表示从六个互补的共语语料库中学习，并支持向不同机器人形态的重定向。定量评估表明，生成的运动在尊重工作空间的同时，仍保持与真实运动分布接近。在一项用户研究中，在修改后的工作空间约束下生成的手势平均质量得分为3.24/5，高于我们的无工作空间变体（2.43/5），低于参考运动（3.68/5）。在实际机器人评估中，所有比较的运动均在相同工作空间约束下重定向至Reachy2人形机器人。使用我们框架生成的运动在69.7%的比较中排名第一，高于无工作空间变体基线以及事后受约束的重定向真实运动。总体而言，研究结果支持在生成过程中将手势适应于可用工作空间，而非在无约束轨迹生成后再进行修改以满足工作空间约束，从而避免潜在的手势自然度损失。

title: Learning to Plan from Random Exploration
summary: Random exploration reveals how an environment can be traversed before a goal is specified. Can this experience support long-range planning without policy-improvement training? Our random-walk analysis explains what temporal relations contain: short horizons reveal geodesic geometry in the diffusion limit, while longer horizons reveal connectivity between regions before mixing removes these distinctions. We learn these relations with a conditional energy-based model that estimates temporal log-density ratios through horizon-conditioned embeddings. The model is trained on observation pairs by noise-contrastive estimation, without action or reward labels. The planner queries these learned relations at different horizons as it moves toward the goal. At test time, a separate local dynamics model predicts candidate action outcomes, and the temporal model evaluates their progress toward the goal by selecting or aggregating estimated improvements across horizons. The agent executes one action and replans with both models fixed. Experiments demonstrate long-range maze planning from random exploration using states and images. Learned score fields, embedding probes, and planned routes exhibit properties of a multiscale cognitive map. We further demonstrate egocentric navigation from random exploration and manipulation planning from suboptimal data.
tldr: This paper introduces a planning method that learns temporal log-density relations from random exploration data without action or reward labels, using a conditional energy-based model, and demonstrates its effectiveness in maze navigation, egocentric navigation, and manipulation planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从随机探索数据中学习时间对数密度关系的规划方法，无需动作或奖励标签，使用条件能量模型，并在迷宫导航、自我中心导航和操作规划中验证了其有效性。
summary_zh: 随机探索揭示了在目标明确之前如何遍历环境。这种经验能否在缺乏策略改进训练的情况下支持长距离规划？我们的随机游走分析阐明了时间关系所包含的内容：短时域在扩散极限下揭示了测地几何结构，而长时域则揭示了区域之间的连通性，直至混合过程消除这些差异。我们通过一种条件能量模型来学习这些关系，该模型利用时域条件嵌入来估计时间对数密度比。该模型通过噪声对比估计在观测对上训练，无需动作或奖励标签。规划器在向目标移动时，在不同时域查询这些学习到的关系。在测试时，一个独立的局部动态模型预测候选动作的结果，而时间模型则通过选择或聚合各个时域上的估计改进来评估这些动作朝目标方向的进展。智能体执行一个动作，并保持两个模型固定不变进行重新规划。实验表明，该方法能够利用状态和图像从随机探索中进行长距离迷宫规划。学习到的评分场、嵌入探针和规划路径展示了多尺度认知地图的特性。我们进一步展示了基于随机探索的自我中心导航以及基于次优数据的操作规划。

title: MEND: Label-Free Detection, Localisation, and Correction of Latent Hallucination in World Models
summary: World Models are appearing as the next major frontier in computer vision. However, their robustness is currently largely unexplored. We identify the phenomenon of hallucination in latent World Models: given a state and an action, the predicted next latent can decode to a scene that never occurs. Because the prediction is statistically ordinary and is fed back autoregressively by the model, the error is both silent and compounding. We study whether such latent hallucination can be detected, localised, and corrected at inference time, on a frozen self-supervised world model in the absence of ground-truth error labels. We introduce Masked Empirical-Bayes Neural Denoising (MEND), a single conditional score network trained by denoising score matching on real transitions, whose score field serves three roles: its magnitude detects hallucination, its per-token field localises it to specific image patches, and it defines an inference-time correction direction. On two navigation environments MEND detects hallucination with an AUROC of up to 0.80 without using actions, exceeding a single-Gaussian density baseline while also localising the error (per-token AUPRC up to 0.87) and correcting it, all from one score field. Our correction reliably reduces single-step latent error and improves predictions. We identify that a part of the error is tangent to the data manifold, hence, we focus on detection and localisation while highlighting promises of the correction.
tldr: MEND introduces a score-based method to detect, localize, and correct latent hallucination in frozen world models without ground-truth labels, using a single conditional denoising network on real transitions.
tldr_zh: MEND 提出了一种基于评分的方法，在无标签条件下检测、定位并修正冻结世界模型中的潜在幻觉，通过真实转移训练的单个去噪网络实现。
summary_zh: 世界模型正成为计算机视觉领域的下一个重大前沿。然而，其鲁棒性目前尚未得到充分探索。我们发现了潜在世界模型中的幻觉现象：给定一个状态和一个动作，预测出的下一个潜在表示可能解码为从未发生过的场景。由于该预测在统计上表现正常，且模型会自回归地将其作为反馈输入，因此这一错误既具有隐蔽性，又具有累积性。我们研究了在推理阶段，是否能够在缺乏真实错误标签的情况下，对冻结的自监督世界模型中的潜在幻觉进行检测、定位和修正。我们提出了掩蔽经验贝叶斯神经去噪方法（MEND），这是一个通过去噪分数匹配在真实转移数据上训练得到的单一条件分数网络，其分数场承担三重作用：其幅度用于检测幻觉，其逐令牌字段将幻觉定位到特定的图像块，并定义了推理阶段的修正方向。在两个导航环境中，MEND在未使用动作信息的情况下，幻觉检测的AUROC高达0.80，超越了单高斯密度基线，同时还能定位错误（逐令牌AUPRC高达0.87）并进行修正，且全部由一个分数场完成。我们的修正方法能够可靠地减少单步潜在错误并改善预测结果。我们发现部分错误与数据流形相切，因此我们重点研究检测与定位，同时展示修正方法的潜力。

title: Exo2EgoHOI: Hand-Object-Interaction Aware Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide valuable visual experience for embodied intelligence, yet collecting such data at scale is costly. Exocentric-to-egocentric video generation offers a scalable alternative by transforming abundant third-person manipulation videos into first-person observations. However, existing methods often struggle to faithfully preserve demonstrated hand-object interactions (HOI) across large viewpoint changes due to insufficient fine-grained interaction guidance and weak object-centric anchoring. We present Exo2EgoHOI, an HOI-aware video generative framework for interaction-preserving exocentric-to-egocentric translation. To preserve fine-grained HOI, we introduce a unified 4D HOI prior that combines scene geometry, articulated hand renderings, and dense hand-object relation fields, together with a dual-branch residual adapter for injecting structural and relational cues into the video generation backbone. To preserve object consistency, we introduce Decomposed Gated Cross-Attention, which separately encodes object and background references and adaptively integrates global semantic and local appearance features as object-centric anchors. Experiments on ARCTIC-HOI and Ego-Exo4D demonstrate substantial improvements in object consistency and HOI preservation while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. In particular, on ARCTIC-HOI, Exo2EgoHOI improves object mIoU by 32.3% and reduces MPJPE and PA-MPJPE by 34.7% and 50.0%, respectively, relative to the respective best baseline results. Project page: https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Exo2EgoHOI/.
tldr: Exo2EgoHOI introduces a hand-object-interaction-aware video generation framework that translates third-person manipulation videos into first-person views, using a unified 4D HOI prior and object-centric gated cross-attention to preserve fine-grained interactions and object consistency.
tldr_zh: Exo2EgoHOI 提出了一种手-物交互感知的视频生成框架，通过统一的4D HOI先验和对象中心的门控交叉注意力，将第三人称操作视频转换为第一人称视角，并保持交互细节和物体一致性。
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的人类操作视频为具身智能提供了宝贵的视觉经验，然而大规模收集此类数据成本高昂。从外部视角到自我中心视角的视频生成提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，通过将丰富的第三人称操作视频转化为第一人称观察来实现。然而，现有方法往往因缺乏细粒度的交互引导和弱目标中心锚定，而在大幅视角变化下难以忠实保留所演示的手-物交互（HOI）。我们提出Exo2EgoHOI，一种面向交互保持的外部到自我中心视频翻译的HOI感知视频生成框架。为保留细粒度HOI，我们引入统一的4D HOI先验，结合场景几何、关节手部渲染和密集手-物关系场，并配以双分支残差适配器，将结构和关系线索注入视频生成主干网络。为保持目标一致性，我们提出分解门控交叉注意力，分别编码目标和背景参考，并自适应整合全局语义与局部外观特征作为目标中心锚点。在ARCTIC-HOI和Ego-Exo4D上的实验表明，在保持竞争性视觉保真度的同时，目标一致性和HOI保持均取得显著提升。特别是在ARCTIC-HOI上，相较于各最优基线结果，Exo2EgoHOI将目标mIoU提升32.3%，并将MPJPE和PA-MPJPE分别降低34.7%和50.0%。项目页面：https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Exo2EgoHOI/。

title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models
summary: When a camera revisits a previously observed region, a video world model should reproduce what was there before. This requires both remembering past observations and retrieving the right one for the current viewpoint. Key-value caches preserve visual detail but grow with video length; recurrent memory is compact but compresses history into a fixed-size state, so individual past observations are no longer directly accessible. We introduce LOCI, a hybrid spatial-memory architecture that keeps both representations. In half of the transformer blocks, main attention keeps a key-value cache of past observations; in the other half, it is restricted to the current chunk and complemented by a recurrent linear-attention memory whose reads and writes are conditioned on projective camera geometry, so viewpoint enters both memory addressing and stored content. Recurrent readouts flow into subsequent cache-backed blocks and supply their queries with accumulated scene context. On the public MIND memory benchmark and on held-out recorded trajectories, LOCI reproduces revisited content more faithfully than representative world models and a same-recipe full-softmax model; with full history, it lowers peak memory at equal length by about 30% relative to full softmax. With a bounded bank of retained observations, it streams long videos at constant memory and remains more faithful than full softmax under the same budget.
tldr: LOCI introduces a hybrid spatial-memory architecture for streaming world models, combining key-value caches and recurrent linear-attention memory conditioned on camera geometry to faithfully reproduce revisited content in videos while maintaining constant memory for long sequences.
tldr_zh: LOCI提出了一种用于流式世界模型的混合空间记忆架构，结合键值缓存和由相机几何条件化的循环线性注意力记忆，在保持长视频恒定内存的同时忠实再现重访内容。
summary_zh: 当相机重新观察之前已经看过的区域时，视频世界模型应当再现该区域此前的内容。这既需要记住过去的观测，也需要针对当前视角检索出正确的历史观测。键值缓存能够保留视觉细节，但会随视频长度增长而扩大；循环记忆虽然紧凑，却将历史压缩为固定大小的状态，因此无法直接访问个别的过去观测。我们提出LOCI，一种混合空间记忆架构，同时保留这两种表征。在一半的Transformer块中，主注意力机制维护过去观测的键值缓存；在另一半块中，主注意力仅限制于当前片段，并由循环线性注意力记忆补充，其读写操作以投影相机几何为条件，从而使视角同时影响记忆寻址和存储内容。循环读出的信息流入后续基于缓存的块中，为其查询提供累积的场景上下文。在公开的MIND记忆基准测试以及保留的录制轨迹上，LOCI对再次访问内容的再现比代表性世界模型以及采用相同方案的全softmax模型更为忠实；在全历史记录下，相比全softmax，同等长度时的峰值内存降低了约30%。在有限的历史观测库预算下，它以恒定内存流式处理长视频，并且在相同预算下仍比全softmax模型更忠实。

title: DyRAD: Radar Novel View Synthesis for Dynamic Driving Scenes
summary: Reconstructing dynamic driving scenes from recorded sensor data supports closed-loop evaluation of autonomous driving systems by synthesizing observations beyond the original trajectory. Unlike cameras and LiDAR, radar measures radial velocity directly through Doppler. Yet existing radar novel-view synthesis fails to exploit this capability: methods addressing dynamic scenes reconstruct only range-azimuth tensors, while methods that render Doppler assume static scenes. Moreover, because radar processing spreads each reflection across multiple bins, existing representations absorb this spread into scene geometry, causing it to render incorrectly when the viewpoint moves. We present DyRAD, which models dynamic driving scenes using static background reflectors and motion-tracked dynamic point reflectors to render complete range-azimuth-Doppler (RAD) tensors. Reflector velocities are derived from object tracks and projected onto the line of sight, making Doppler both a rendered output and supervision for those tracks. Crucially, we render reflectors through a fixed analytic point-spread function (PSF) derived from the radar's signal-processing chain, preventing sensor-induced spread from being baked into the scene representation. Beyond improving scene reconstruction, this separation also enables zero-shot sensor-configuration transfer, allowing the same reconstructed scene to be rendered under different radar specifications without refitting. We evaluate DyRAD on RADIal, Boreas, and a synthetic benchmark across both on-path poses and displaced viewpoints untested by prior work. On RADIal, DyRAD recovers radar detections in 90.7% of reference-detected objects, compared with 26.9% for the strongest baseline.
tldr: DyRAD models dynamic driving scenes with static and motion-tracked dynamic radar reflectors to render range-azimuth-Doppler tensors, using a fixed analytic point-spread function to separate sensor-induced spread from scene geometry, enabling zero-shot sensor-configuration transfer.
tldr_zh: DyRAD 通过静态背景反射器和运动跟踪的动态点反射器建模动态驾驶场景，渲染距离-方位-多普勒张量，并利用固定解析点扩散函数分离传感器引起的扩散，从而实现零样本传感器配置迁移。
summary_zh: 从记录的传感器数据重建动态驾驶场景，通过合成原始轨迹之外的观测，支持自动驾驶系统的闭环评估。与摄像头和激光雷达不同，雷达通过多普勒效应直接测量径向速度。然而，现有的雷达新视角合成方法未能利用这一能力：处理动态场景的方法仅重建距离-方位张量，而渲染多普勒的方法则假设场景是静态的。此外，由于雷达处理会将每个反射信号扩散到多个单元中，现有表示将这种扩散吸收到场景几何中，导致视角移动时渲染错误。我们提出DyRAD，利用静态背景反射体和运动跟踪的动态点反射体对动态驾驶场景建模，以渲染完整的距离-方位-多普勒张量。反射体速度从目标轨迹中推导并投影到视线方向，使得多普勒既是渲染输出，也是这些轨迹的监督信号。关键在于，我们通过从雷达信号处理链推导出的固定解析点扩散函数来渲染反射体，防止传感器引起的扩散被固化到场景表示中。除了改善场景重建外，这种分离还实现了零样本传感器配置迁移，使同一重建场景无需重新拟合即可在不同雷达规格下渲染。我们在RADIal、Boreas以及一个合成基准上对DyRAD进行评估，涵盖沿路径姿态和先前工作未测试的偏移视角。在RADIal上，DyRAD在90.7%的参考检测目标中恢复了雷达检测，而最强基线仅为26.9%。

title: AdaOcc: Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction for Embodied Tasks
summary: Embodied tasks demand accurate, flexible, and semantically rich 3D scene representations. 3D semantic occupancy is well suited to this requirement, as it can model holistic 3D spaces by encoding geometric occupancy along with semantic categories. However, existing occupancy prediction methods struggle to meet practical deployment requirements, such as adapting to varying computing budgets, sensor setups, and observation views. In this paper, we propose a point-based Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction method, called AdaOcc, tailored for embodied scenarios. To accommodate heterogeneous sensor inputs, AdaOcc uses an adaptive geometry-guided dual-branch encoder that can support RGB images in various numbers of views with (estimated) depth maps or LiDAR scans. AdaOcc represents occupied regions via sparse semantic points trained with a progressive query learning strategy, allowing the prediction computational budget to be flexibly adjusted through query point numbers and decoder layers. To facilitate high-fidelity geometric modeling for lightweight point-based occupancy learning, we further propose a novel containment loss that regularizes predicted points to reside within valid occupied regions. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves a new state-of-the-art on Occ-ScanNet with considerable performance improvements over previous methods. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong practical applicability as an adaptive 3D perception module in real-world embodied systems.
tldr: This paper proposes AdaOcc, an adaptive point-based 3D occupancy prediction method tailored for embodied tasks, featuring a dual-branch encoder for heterogeneous sensor inputs and a containment loss for improved geometric modeling, achieving state-of-the-art results on Occ-ScanNet.
tldr_zh: 本文提出AdaOcc，一种面向具身任务的自适应点基3D占用预测方法，具备双分支编码器以处理异构传感器输入，并通过包含损失改进几何建模，在Occ-ScanNet上达到最先进性能。
summary_zh: 具身任务要求三维场景表示具备准确性、灵活性和丰富的语义信息。三维语义占用(3D semantic occupancy)通过编码几何占用及语义类别来建模整体三维空间，因此非常契合这一需求。然而，现有的占用预测方法难以满足实际部署要求，例如适应不同的计算预算、传感器配置和观察视角。本文提出了一种基于点的自适应三维占用预测方法，称为AdaOcc，专门针对具身场景设计。为适配异构传感器输入，AdaOcc采用自适应几何引导的双分支编码器，能够支持不同视角数量的RGB图像及其（估计）深度图或激光雷达扫描数据。AdaOcc通过稀疏语义点表示占用区域，并采用渐进式查询学习策略进行训练，从而可通过查询点数量和解码器层数灵活调整预测计算预算。为促进轻量级基于点的占用学习实现高保真几何建模，我们进一步提出了一种新颖的包含损失(containment loss)，对预测点进行正则化以使其位于有效占用区域内。大量实验表明，我们的方法在Occ-ScanNet上取得了新的最先进性能，相较以往方法有显著提升。此外，该框架作为自适应三维感知模块，在真实具身系统中展现出强大的实际应用能力。

title: GPU-Accelerated Path-Dependent Marginal Information Gain for Autonomous Exploration
summary: Autonomous exploration demands that robots continuously evaluate candidate viewpoints based on their expected information gain and execution cost. Sampling-based planners estimate this gain by volumetric raycasting and, due to its computational cost, evaluate candidates under an assumption of mutual independence, ignoring the overlap between viewpoints along the same path. This work presents a GPU-accelerated method for computing path-dependent marginal information gain, where instead of storing and merging the observed unknown voxels along each candidate path, previous observations are represented using depth buffers. Candidate rays are projected into the depth buffers of their ancestors to identify observation overlap and exclude regions expected to be observed. The planning tree is evaluated in depth order to maintain the dependency between viewpoints and their optimized yaws, while candidate nodes and rays at each level are processed in parallel on the GPU. The proposed method stays within 5-10% of the exact marginal gain computed using voxel hash maps, with speed-ups of up to 118x on a desktop GPU and 28x on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. The method was integrated into two sampling-based exploration planners and evaluated in three simulation environments, where marginal gain reduced the time to 95% coverage in five of the six evaluated planner-environment combinations. Real-world experiments also showed a 30% reduction in the time to 95% coverage, as well as earlier exploration termination times.
tldr: This paper introduces a GPU-accelerated method for computing path-dependent marginal information gain in autonomous exploration, using depth buffers to efficiently account for observation overlap along candidate paths, achieving significant speedups and improved coverage times in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种GPU加速的路径依赖边际信息增益计算方法，用于自主探索，通过深度缓冲来高效处理候选路径上的观测重叠，在仿真和真实实验中显著提升速度并缩短覆盖时间。
summary_zh: 自主探索要求机器人基于预期信息增益和执行成本持续评估候选视角。基于采样的规划器通过体积射线投射来估计这一增益，但由于其计算成本较高，通常在候选视角间相互独立的假设下进行评估，忽略了同一路径上各视角之间的重叠部分。本研究提出了一种基于GPU加速的路径相关边际信息增益计算方法，该方法不再沿每条候选路径存储并合并已观测的未知体素，而是利用深度缓冲区表示先前的观测结果。候选射线被投影至其祖先节点的深度缓冲区中，以识别观测重叠区域并排除预期已被观测的区域。规划树按深度顺序评估，以维持各视角及其优化偏航角之间的依赖关系，同时每一层的候选节点和射线在GPU上并行处理。所提方法与使用体素哈希表计算的精确边际增益相比，误差保持在5%至10%以内，在桌面GPU上加速比高达118倍，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上加速比达28倍。该方法已集成至两种基于采样的探索规划器中，并在三个仿真环境中进行了评估，在六种规划器—环境组合中的五种里，边际增益将达到95%覆盖率的时间缩短至原时长的相应比例。真实世界实验同样表明，达到95%覆盖率的时间减少了30%，且探索终止时间有所提前。

title: Active Mapping of Underwater Litter Using Camera-Sonar Fusion
summary: Marine litter is a growing threat to the underwater ecosystem, driving demand for autonomous survey methods that can locate debris efficiently over large areas. Existing survey methods typically follow predefined paths or operate with a single sensing modality, typically a camera (with image quality suffering in poor-visibility conditions) or sonar (usually noisy and low-resolution). We present an active mapping framework in which a forward-looking sonar and a camera both feed into a shared Bayesian occupancy map, and an optimization problem is solved at each step to decide on the next best view. Candidate viewpoints are scored by a two-term utility that balances exploration of uncertain regions via voxel entropy against exploitation of likely objects. Each sensor is characterized by range- and bearing-dependent detection and false-alarm probability tables determined from data. We evaluate the approach in a realistic underwater simulator, demonstrating that active mapping finds objects faster than a lawnmower coverage pattern, and that the dual-sensor approach works better than using either of the individual sensors.
tldr: An active mapping framework for underwater litter using camera and sonar fusion with a shared Bayesian occupancy map and next-best-view optimization.
tldr_zh: 一种用于水下垃圾的主动测绘框架，利用相机和声纳融合以及共享贝叶斯占用图和次优视角优化。
summary_zh: 海洋垃圾对水下生态系统构成日益严重的威胁，这推动了对自主调查方法的需求，以在大范围内高效定位碎片。现有的调查方法通常沿预定路径行驶，或仅依赖单一传感模态，通常是摄像头（在低能见度条件下图像质量会下降）或声纳（通常噪声大且分辨率低）。我们提出了一种主动建图框架，在该框架中，前视声纳和摄像头共同输入到一个共享的贝叶斯占用地图中，并在每一步求解一个优化问题，以决定下一个最佳视角。候选视角通过一个双项效用函数进行评分，该函数平衡了通过体素熵探索不确定区域与利用疑似目标之间的权衡。每种传感器均通过由数据确定的与距离和方位相关的检测概率及虚警概率表进行表征。我们在一个逼真的水下模拟器中评估了该方法，结果表明主动建图比割草机式覆盖路径更快地找到目标，且双传感器方法的效果优于单独使用任一传感器。

title: Markovian Dynamics Enforcer: Feasibility Preserving Correction on Learned Dynamics Manifolds
summary: Neural trajectory predictors can reach low prediction error while violating dynamics, actuator limits, or state constraints, especially when controls are unobserved and dynamics are partially specified. We introduce the Markovian Dynamics Enforcer (MaDE), a time-invariant post-hoc operator mapping state-transition proposals onto a learned feasible dynamics manifold, trained on feasible states without ground-truth controls. For each transition it infers a control and recomputes the state through a completion model of known physics plus a learned residual. It then corrects that control by gradient-based inequality reduction, so inequality satisfaction is best-effort within an iteration budget. Since every correction iterate re-enters the completion model, the returned state is dynamically consistent by construction relative to that model and the supplied previous-state anchor. MaDE drives dynamics residuals to essentially zero on fully specified simulated systems, and on an underspecified system leaves a smaller true-dynamics residual than the baselines. Designed to attach to arbitrary predictors, the frozen operator is evaluated downstream of recurrent, structured state-space, and transformer predictors. On recorded vehicle trajectories the one-step residual against a kinematic bicycle model is 0.0071 to 0.0072 for MaDE and 0.1703 to 0.1714 for raw predictors. MaDE raises average displacement error by a factor of 1.57 to 1.83.
tldr: MaDE is a post-hoc operator that corrects arbitrary neural trajectory predictors by projecting state transitions onto a feasible dynamics manifold, reducing dynamics residuals on vehicle trajectories while slightly increasing displacement error.
tldr_zh: MaDE 是一种后处理算子，通过将状态转移投影到可行动力学流形上来修正任意神经轨迹预测器，在车辆轨迹上降低动力学残差，但略微增加位移误差。
summary_zh: 神经轨迹预测器在违反动力学、执行器限制或状态约束的情况下仍能达到较低的预测误差，尤其是在控制量未被观测且动力学部分已知时。我们提出了马尔可夫动力学强制器（MaDE），一种时不变的后处理算子，将状态转移提议映射到学习得到的可行动力学流形上，并在无真实控制量标注的可行状态上进行训练。对于每个转移，它推断出一个控制量，并通过由已知物理模型加学习残差构成的补全模型重新计算状态。随后，它通过基于梯度的不等式缩减来修正该控制量，使得不等式满足在给定迭代预算内达到尽力而为的效果。由于每次修正迭代都会重新进入补全模型，返回的状态相对于该模型及所提供的前一状态锚点在构造上即满足动力学一致性。MaDE在完全指定的模拟系统上将动力学残差降至几乎为零，在欠指定系统上则留下比基线方法更小的真实动力学残差。该冻结算子设计为可附加到任意预测器之后，在循环神经网络、结构化状态空间模型及Transformer预测器的下游进行评估。在记录的车辆轨迹上，针对运动学自行车模型的一步残差，MaDE为0.0071至0.0072，而原始预测器为0.1703至0.1714。MaDE使平均位移误差增加了1.57至1.83倍。

title: General Performance Guarantee for Human Torque Estimation-Based Task-Agnostic Assistive Exoskeleton Control
summary: Accurate human torque estimation is crucial for enabling task-agnostic control in robotic exoskeleton systems. However, estimation errors may cause mismatches between the robot assistance and the human intention, degrading controllability and task performance. In this paper, we address this issue by formally defining matched assistance as scenarios in which the robot positively contributes to human movement. Based on this definition, we develop a theoretical framework to design the robot's desired interaction torque that guarantees a lower bound on the matched assistance probability. Importantly, the proposed guarantee holds over the entire torque distribution, including unseen data beyond the training tasks. This provides our method with strong reliability and generalization, both of which are critical for effective exoskeleton control. The proposed strategy is implemented on the ABLE upper-limb exoskeleton and evaluated in a multi-task setup. Experimental results validate the theoretical guarantees and demonstrate that the proposed strategy achieves effective general performance across several tasks, guaranteeing movement smoothness while reducing human physical effort.
tldr: This paper proposes a theoretical framework for task-agnostic assistive exoskeleton control that guarantees a lower bound on matched assistance probability, even on unseen torque distributions, and validates it on an upper-limb exoskeleton.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个任务无关辅助外骨骼控制的理论框架，保证匹配辅助概率的下界，即使面对未见过的力矩分布也成立，并在上肢外骨骼上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 准确估计人体力矩对于实现机器人外骨骼系统中的任务无关控制至关重要。然而，估计误差可能导致机器人辅助与人类意图之间的不匹配，从而降低可控性和任务表现。本文针对这一问题，将匹配辅助正式定义为机器人对人类运动产生积极贡献的场景。基于这一定义，我们构建了一个理论框架，用于设计机器人的期望交互力矩，以确保匹配辅助概率的下界。重要的是，所提出的保证适用于整个力矩分布，包括训练任务之外的未见数据。这为我们的方法提供了强大的可靠性和泛化能力，这两者对于有效的外骨骼控制都至关重要。所提出的策略已在ABLE上肢外骨骼上实现，并在多任务设置中进行了评估。实验结果验证了理论保证，并表明所提出的策略在多个任务中实现了有效的整体性能，在保证运动平滑性的同时减少了人体的体力消耗。

title: Benchmarking EMlog Calibration for Autonomous Surface Vehicles
summary: Accurate velocity measurement is a fundamental requirement for autonomous surface and underwater vehicles. Commonly, velocity is provided by a Doppler velocity log (DVL) sensor, yet it becomes unavailable due to operational altitude constraints. In such situations, electromagnetic logs (EMLogs) provide a critically robust alternative for continuous velocity estimation. However, raw EMLog measurements are inherently corrupted by systematic errors, which need to be calibrated prior mission begins. Currently, a benchmarking comparative evaluation of how different calibration models perform under rapidly changing dynamic sea conditions is missing in the literature. To bridge this gap, this paper presents a comparative model-based calibration methodology that evaluates four distinct calibration models using two different estimation pipelines. The proposed framework is rigorously validated on a unique 221 minutes of continuous real-world telemetry collected from the MARVEL surface vehicle during dynamic sea trials. The dataset contains two different EMLogs and DVL recordings. Experimental results demonstrate that the bias and scale error model implemented with the Kalman filter improves the speed estimation by 71%. We also demonstrate that dynamical manoeuvres further improve the accuracy compared to standard straight-line paths, ultimately delivering a validated, real-time online calibration EMLog approach for autonomous surface vehicles.
tldr: This paper presents a comparative benchmarking of four calibration models for electromagnetic logs (EMLogs) on autonomous surface vehicles, using two estimation pipelines and real-world telemetry, achieving a 71% improvement in speed estimation.
tldr_zh: 本文针对自主水面航行器上的电磁日志（EMLog）校准，使用两种估计流程和真实遥测数据，对四种校准模型进行了比较基准测试，速度估计精度提升71%。
summary_zh: 精确的速度测量是自主水面与水下航行器的一项基本要求。通常，速度由多普勒测速仪（DVL）传感器提供，但因运行高度限制，该传感器可能无法使用。在此类情况下，电磁计程仪（EMLogs）为连续速度估计提供了一种至关重要的稳健替代方案。然而，EMLog原始测量值本质上会受到系统性误差的影响，需要在任务开始前进行校准。目前，文献中尚缺少对不同校准模型在快速变化的动态海况下性能进行对比基准评估的研究。为填补这一空白，本文提出了一种基于模型的比较校准方法，利用两种不同的估计流程对四种不同的校准模型进行评估。该框架在MARVEL水面航行器动态海上试验中采集的221分钟连续真实遥测数据上得到了严格验证，数据集中包含两种不同的EMLog及DVL记录。实验结果表明，采用卡尔曼滤波器实现的偏差与比例因子误差模型可将速度估计精度提升71%。此外，我们还证明，动态机动相较于标准直线航迹能进一步提高精度，最终为自主水面航行器提供了一种经过验证的实时在线校准EMLog方法。

title: Concurrent Semantic Search and Mission Execution for LTL Missions in Unknown Environments
summary:
